query_text: Highlight the importance of discipling others who will disciple others. Call the church to mentor, train, and empower the next generation to carry on the faith legacy.

A lot of young people are confused about their identity that affects the way they perceive themselves. Our true identity is found in who God says we are, not in our past, our failures, or even our own doubts.

God invites us to a place of community a place to experience His love, mercy, grace, and protection. God brings people together in faith communities like churches to walk together, support each other, and experience love that goes beyond disposable relationships.
God places people in our lives to help us grow into our God-given destiny. Young people need spiritual leaders who will guide and walk with them as they grow into their God-given destiny and purpose.

God redeems our past and calls us into a purposeful future for His glory. Purpose starts when someone trust the power of God into his life. No excuses can disqualifies us from God's purpose. When God calls us, our life becomes meaningful and he can use it as an instrument for His mission.
Our people will understand the role of Holy Spirit as our Helper that will be with us forever
Our people will know Holy Spirit who will Teach and bring to remembrance the lessons taught by Christ
